source: Important. “Top-1 is simpler” is not the same claim as “Top-1 is universally better.” Later successful models use Top-2, Top-8, and other routing budgets.ZXMATH0000XZ is an architectural and systems choice.
zh: 重要。 “Top-1 更简单”与“Top-1 普遍更好”并不是同一说法。后来的成功模型使用 Top-2、Top-8 和其他路由预算。ZXMATH0000XZ 是一种架构和系统选择。
